item.title: Shaheen Chowk Underpass Set for Smooth Islamabad Drives
item.description: Islamabad commuters will soon enjoy smoother drives as the Shaheen Chowk Underpass opens to traffic on December 31, 2025. This key infrastructure project targets long-standing congestion at one of the capital’s busiest intersections. Islamabad’s roads often face heavy traffic, especially at Shaheen Chowk. item.title: Toyota and Lexus Top the List of Longest-Lasting Car Brands
item.description: If you want a car that will hit 250,000 miles, Toyota is your best bet. A new study by iSeeCars, a U.S.-based research firm, analyzed over 174 million vehicles and found that Toyota ranks #1 for longevity. The data shows that a Toyota has a 17.8% chance of reaching 250,000 miles (402,336 km).
